title: Titan X Triple Berry Prefilled Pod + Refills
description: The Titan X Refill Kit in Triple Berry is designed for use with the Titan X Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. This easy-to-use refill pack includes a 2ml prefilled mouthpiece pod and three 5ml flavour-matched auto-refill capsules, offering smooth, consistent flavour without the need for manual refilling. Just click the pod and capsules into place on your Titan X device and you’re ready to go. Triple Berry blends the lush, juicy flavours of Blackberry, Raspberry and Blueberry into a rich, layered fruit vape. Sweet, slightly tart, and bursting with berry character, this flavour is balanced by a smooth nicotine salt formulation for a comfortable mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape and rapid nicotine relief. Complete with a pre-installed mesh coil for enhanced flavour delivery and vapour production, the Titan X Refill Kit pairs seamlessly with the Titan X device’s smart auto-refill system, offering up to approximately 10,000 puffs per refill cycle (usage-dependent).
